Subject: Intro: AWS co-sell intro & joint sprint plan for Acme Health

Hi Sana and Tom,

Quick note to introduce the teams and get alignment on a short joint sprint to validate an AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell motion for Acme Health. Vanessa (CS lead) and Karthik (GTMs/marketplace) are looped in to help scope the playbook and intake.

High-level asks:
- Can AWS introduce a TAM/Partner SA who can join a 30-min discovery call next week?
- Tom: if you can share any procurement timelines or marketplace requirements up front that would help (vendor onboarding, SOC/compliance checklist).
- Vanessa/Karthik: we'll draft a one-week sprint plan (tech fit, listing checklist, co-sell handoff).

Proposed slots for discovery: Wed 11/17 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 11/18 14:00-14:30 PT.

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Business Development, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachment: none (will follow with sprint doc)

Thanks for the intro Priyom — happy to help. I can bring in Rajesh (Partner SA) to run a short architecture review on the discovery.

Rajesh's availability: Wed 11/17 10:00-10:30 PT works; he can also extend the call to 45 minutes if we need quick infra/config questions.

Tom — curious about the procurement window you mentioned on the call last month. Any target go-live or preferred timeline for being in the marketplace? Also, do you have an internal listing owner we should coordinate with?

I'll set a calendar invite for Wed 11/17 10:00 PT and include a short intake form.

Best,

Subject: Re: Intro: AWS co-sell intro & joint sprint plan for Acme Health

Hi all,

Wed 11/17 10:00 PT works for us. Quick context: our procurement window for Q1 2027 is tight — we aim to be in marketplace approval by end of Dec if possible. Primary asks from our side:
- Marketplace listing criteria (security attestation, data residency, support model)
- Commercial packaging options (reserved vs consumption)
- Any pre-populated marketing assets AWS needs for co-sell enablement

Procurement contact is Sarah Li (procurement@acmehealth.com) — cc'd. Looking forward to the call.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, IT Procurement
Acme Health

Owners and immediate asks summarized:
- Acme (Tom / Sarah): SOC2 or compliance packet, and the marketing asset owner contact by 11/12 (Tom said EOD 11/12).
- Redwood (Vanessa / Rafael): finalize sprint doc and prepare a short demo of the Marketplace listing UI.

Thanks — see you on Wed.
